descriptions.backup: A .zip exported from Initiative, put back as it was.
descriptions.atlassian: Projects and spaces read straight from your Atlassian site.
descriptions.ticktick: A backup CSV holding every list.
descriptions.vikunja: The data.json from a Vikunja export.

file.hint: Upload the file you exported from {{source}}.

where.todoist: Project menu → Export → Export as CSV
where.vikunja: Settings → Data export — unzip it and pick data.json

file.nothingInIt: There is nothing to import in that file.
file.unreadable: That file doesn't read as this export. Check you picked the right one.
file.todoistOmitsCompleted: Todoist leaves completed tasks out of its export, so only outstanding work will arrive.

choose.prompt: What should come across, and where to?
choose.note: This arrives as a new project. Its columns become statuses, and its tags, dates and comments come with it.

pick.hint: A .zip exported from Initiative's community or initiative backup.
pick.notZip: This file isn't a valid Initiative backup.
pick.readFailed: Couldn't read this backup file. It may be corrupted.
pick.tooLarge: This file is larger than the {{limit}} upload limit.

peek.note: Nothing is uploaded yet — review and continue to upload.

plan.willCreate: "{{name}}" will be imported as a new initiative "{{proposed}}"
plan.skipped_one: {{count}} item was left out of this backup by its exporter
plan.skipped_other: {{count}} items were left out of this backup by its exporter
plan.unknownTypes: Unknown content types will be skipped: {{types}}
plan.note: Each initiative in the backup is created fresh — nothing existing is changed. The import runs in the background.

people.note: Pick who each person is here. Exact handle matches are filled in; leave one blank to keep just their name.
people.access: Anyone assigned, invited or named in a property is added to the initiative if you manage it, and gets access to what's imported.

progress.title: Importing…
progress.note: This can take a while. You can close this dialog — you'll get a notification, and the report stays available in community settings.

report.title: Import finished
report.unmatchedHandles: Some people weren't placed. Nobody here matched them, or you can't add them to this initiative: {{handles}}

connect.note: The token is used only to read what you pick, and it's deleted as soon as it's been read.
connect.failed: We couldn't connect to that site.
connect.noProducts: We reached the site, but this token can't see any Jira projects or Confluence spaces.

choose.prompt: What should come across, and where to?
choose.note: Each project arrives as a new project and each space as a new wiki in this initiative, with links between them joined up. Nothing is written until you've reviewed what we found.
choose.initiativeHint: Only initiatives where you can add everything you've ticked are listed.

export.offer: Have an HTML export of a Confluence space instead? Upload it
export.prompt: Upload a Confluence space's HTML export.
export.where: In Confluence: Space settings → Export space → HTML
export.note: Nothing is written until you've reviewed what we found. People are matched by the names the export prints.
export.failed: We couldn't start reading that export.
export.notExport: That zip isn't a Confluence space's HTML export.

fetch.title: Reading your Atlassian site…
fetch.progress: {{tasks}} tasks from {{projects}} projects and {{pages}} pages from {{spaces}} spaces read so far
fetch.note: This can take a few minutes for a large project. You can close this window; opening the import again brings you back here.
fetch.failed: We couldn't read what you picked.

atlassian.crossLinks_one: {{count}} link between an issue and a page, joined up
atlassian.crossLinks_other: {{count}} links between issues and pages, joined up

review.prompt: Here's what we found. Nothing has been written yet.
review.files_one: {{count}} attached file, as a file on its task ({{size}})
review.files_other: {{count}} attached files, each as a file on its task ({{size}})
review.propertiesHint: Untick any you don't want added to this initiative.
review.projectsOverLimit: Not brought over in full, because the import reached its size limit: {{keys}}
review.noCalendar: sprints need calendars, which this initiative doesn't have
review.sprintsUndated_one: {{count}} sprint that never started, so it has no dates
review.sprintsUndated_other: {{count}} sprints that never started, so they have no dates
review.linksOutside_one: {{count}} link to an issue you didn't pick
review.linksOutside_other: {{count}} links to issues you didn't pick
review.commentsRestricted_one: {{count}} comment only some people could see in Jira
review.commentsRestricted_other: {{count}} comments only some people could see in Jira
review.imagesSkipped_one: {{count}} image that's too large or couldn't be read
review.imagesSkipped_other: {{count}} images that are too large or couldn't be read
review.otherAttachments_one: {{count}} attached file that isn't an image stays behind
review.otherAttachments_other: {{count}} attached files that aren't images stay behind
review.note: Starting the import writes all of this into the initiative you picked. Cancel throws it away.

review.containers_one: {{count}} folder or empty parent page becomes a list of the pages under it
review.containers_other: {{count}} folders or empty parent pages become lists of the pages under them
review.comments_one: {{count}} comment on the pages, footer and inline
review.comments_other: {{count}} comments on the pages, footer and inline
review.spacesOverLimit: Not brought over in full, because the import reached its size limit: {{keys}}
review.overLimit_one: {{count}} page would make the wiki too large to import in one go
review.overLimit_other: {{count}} pages would make the wiki too large to import in one go
review.attachments_one: {{count}} attached file stays behind, because attachments were switched off
review.attachments_other: {{count}} attached files stay behind, because attachments were switched off
review.attachmentsArriving_one: {{count}} attachment ({{size}}): pictures where the pages show them, files in the wiki
review.attachmentsArriving_other: {{count}} attachments ({{size}}): pictures where the pages show them, files in the wiki
review.attachmentsSkipped_one: {{count}} attachment that's too large or couldn't be read
review.attachmentsSkipped_other: {{count}} attachments that are too large or couldn't be read
review.filesBlocked_one: {{count}} file, because this initiative has files switched off
review.filesBlocked_other: {{count}} files, because this initiative has files switched off

envelope.title: Import from file
envelope.description: Import a file exported from Initiative: a JSON file, or a zip when the export came with its files, like a catalog's pictures. Its contents are created in the initiative you choose.
envelope.parseError: This file isn't a recognized Initiative export.
envelope.wrongTool: This file is a {{type}} export — import it from that tool's page.
envelope.fileTooLarge: This file is too large to import.
envelope.limitUnavailable: Upload limits could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
envelope.archivePreview: A zipped export with its files. It's read when you import it.
envelope.queued: Import started — you'll get a notification when it finishes.
envelope.warningUnmatched_one: {{count}} person wasn't placed. Nobody here matched them, or you can't add them to this initiative: {{handles}}
envelope.warningUnmatched_other: {{count}} people weren't placed. Nobody here matched them, or you can't add them to this initiative: {{handles}}

dataTab.importDescription: Restore an initiative or community backup zip. Each backed-up initiative is created as a new initiative — nothing existing is changed.
